Partner with eMbrace

Building an Inclusive Future Together

At eMbrace, we believe in the power of collaboration to create inclusive, neurodivergent-friendly environments across schools, workplaces, and healthcare. Our expertise in mental health, developmental assessments, therapy, and training allows us to work with organizations, startups, and institutions to make mental healthcare and neurodiversity support more accessible.

Our Current Collaborations

We are proud to collaborate with leading organizations dedicated to inclusivity, mental health, and neurodevelopmental support.

Free · 3 minutes · private

Stressed, or burnt out? They need different things.

Our self-check gives you four separate scores — worry, mood, body and sleep, and burnout — because those four problems look identical from the outside and respond to completely different treatment. Your answers stay in your browser, and the 7-Day Reset Plan has a track for whichever one is heaviest.
